observations: Root completed the ordered image-first second reading of the whole scan and both actual supplied halves, followed by both witnesses, every line of agreed text and the inventories. All 79 fresh crop recipes were personally viewed. Five margin previews initially lacked declared grayscale/contrast processing because of a helper defect; those five were regenerated with all declared settings and personally re-viewed before finalization. The two new margin crops were generated directly with those settings. The faint note remains uncertain, with no inferred sentence supplied. Enlargements confirm the faint equals sign and dotted i in the CM2 formula, both j/i index orders as actually written, the triangular Delta in the sigma-prime definition, all quotient parentheses and primes, the lower sloping geq bars, the double-bar leqq ranges, E in id_E, and the two-dot basis ellipsis. Both plus shapes are now read without a doubt mark; all repeated round indices and the exponent are qualified locally. The handwritten lineairement has no acute; semi invariants has no hyphen. Overtyped pour and du are qualified. Physical line divisions, the uncertain mark after al, live c.q.f d., final quptient, the extra locally cancelled letter between bi and en, the typed s beneath capital S, the raised number-point and the full heading loops are preserved. The final abbreviation under x overtyping has uncertain punctuation. All cancellations and insertion drawings were rechecked, including the broad black passage that remains physically unreadable. The upper diagonal of the pencil bracket is added. Manuscript 23 and archive 54 remain distinct. No context or mathematical proof check was used.

upsert_changes.place: all round coefficient and basis indices and exponent
upsert_changes.shows: The first and later e subscripts, all a subscripts in the opening paragraph, and the exponent in eta(a_i^o) are closed upright ovals. Their shapes do not securely distinguish letter o from zero, so every occurrence is qualified in place.

There are two distinct crossing pairs of strokes. The first is faint and offset left of the dark second plus, but both horizontal and vertical arms are visible. No cancellation stroke is identifiable; both plus shapes are retained without asserting their intended mathematical function.
The fresh crop includes the space above the handwritten e and the typed line above. No independent acute accent is present on the handwritten word. Its unaccented spelling is retained.

The separator has a dense upper body and a distinctly descending hooked lower stroke. These favour a semicolon-like form over a point, but the repeated upper retracing prevents a secure single punctuation reading.

The preceding line ends with cancelled in and a clipped terminal hyphen; clus dans H and the letters c q f d remain visible through x overtyping on the next line. The x impressions cover the abbreviation separator positions, so the punctuation remains qualified.

upsert_changes.final: Single straight line with four deeper loops, a shallow loop and right curl in TikZ
upsert_changes.shows: The enlargement shows a faint first descending loop, then three darker deep loops, a shallow loop under the last digits, and a terminal downward curl. The first faint loop is retained rather than reduced to three loops in all.

upsert_changes.final: TikZ curved bracket with upper diagonal arm and lower bent arrow
upsert_changes.shows: The upper horizontal arm has a separate diagonal return to its right tip. The long faint curved bracket and lower bent mark remain; the added upper diagonal is now reproduced.
Separate terminal hyphens are visible at the line ends, including the cancelled words; the following fragments start the next lines.

upsert_changes.place: faint division after al in theorem
upsert_changes.shows: A faint short horizontal-looking mark stands after al, above the baseline, before gébrique on the next line. A hyphen is favoured but a point-like impression cannot be excluded.
The final position has the dark stem, upper serif and shoulder of r over a rounded e-like lower body. The impression order is not secure.
The second letter has a u-shaped body and a substantial y-like descender. Both impressions are preserved as alternatives without assigning their order.
The handwritten semi ends before a clear gap, followed by the initial i of invariants. No hyphen is present in that gap.
There are points after c, q and d, but the interval after f is blank. The missing point is not supplied.

upsert_changes.place: extra locally cancelled letter in final si bien
upsert_changes.shows: Between the typed i and e is a separately blackened full letter position. A u-shaped body is possible, but the local cancellation obscures it. This extra character is retained with doubt inside the later whole-clause deletion.
After q and u, the third letter has the bowl and descender of p. The remaining tient is clear.
A small typed s remains under the much taller handwritten capital S; the replacement is written across that lower original letter.
